errors.reason: Recognized coordinator terminal receipt and owned stopped-service/closed-port receipt required before packaging. New archive/manifest/verification paths use exclusive creation. Each evidence root must exist, be nonempty and resolve inside workspace. Whole inventory and each file size/mtime are checked before/after read and again after ZIP close.

consistency.reason: Original evidence is only read. SHA256/byte manifest covers each archive member, archive checksum is recorded and existing restore verifier is called with write=False. Failed/missing stage outcomes are retained rather than replaced. No active archive execution was performed during pilot.

paper_topic.reason: Package preserves historical interrupted run, new development run, new preparation and recovery audits as separately named evidence. Packaging makes no semantic-success, hypothesis or main-readiness claim and changes no sources, treatments, output or inference parameters.

resolved_findings.resolution: inventory requires each expected evidence directory and a nonempty file list instead of silently skipping missing rglob roots.
initial path-to-size/mtime inventory is required before every read and complete inventory is compared again after archive closes, before success manifest.

limitations: Parent must ensure all report writers have completed before packaging, as coordinated.
Size/mtime stability is an operational change detector; it is not protection against deliberate byte edits that preserve timestamps and length.
Partial archive after a detected error remains a failed artifact and receives no success manifest; caller must not silently overwrite it.
No runtime or automated test execution was performed in this static review.
